blurb: Guests can experience Algonquin Park by canoe on multiday guided adventures with camping, or on 6-hour day tours including paddling workshops, wildlife viewing, and optional cliff jumping. Winter tours offer guided snowshoe adventures exploring snow-covered forests and frozen lakes. Workshops provide skills in photography, canoeing, and canoe tripping.
